notes: Transcriber layout note: header is printed on two levels. Upper level reads 'Process / SRT (d) / MLSS (mg/L) / Retention time (hrs) / Return Activated Sludge % of influent (%) / Internal Recycle % of influent (%)'; lower level reads 'Total / Anaerobic / Anoxic / Aerobic' under Retention time (hrs).
Stage order is printed with superscript ordinals ('1st', '2nd', '3rd', '4th', '5th'); written here on the text baseline.

The 4-stage row prints only two retention-time pairs (1st stage and 3rd stage anoxic, 2nd stage and 4th stage aerobic) with no anaerobic value ('-'); the 5-stage row prints an anaerobic value and shifts the stage ordinals. Both retained as printed.
The two 'Anoxic' and 'Aerobic' cells hold two printed lines each; the line break is retained inside the cell.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page render and 300-420 dpi crops; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: Both data rows read from a 420 dpi crop, including the superscript ordinals and the two-line anoxic/aerobic cells.

visual_recheck.method: distinct second visual inspection of exact source-region renders (incl. rotated/zoomed crops) by parent assistant; not independent human review
visual_recheck.observations: Parent compared every cell, header and note against 144-dpi region renders (all five rotated T5.29 regions included).
